name: clone-guard-security-scanning
description: Dev tooling for the CloneGuard Security Scanning WordPress plugin (not shipped).

scripts.lint:php: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app -w /app php:8.4-cli sh -c 'find . -name "*.php" -not -path "./node_modules/*" -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l'
scripts.plugin-check: wp-env run cli wp plugin check clone-guard-security-scanning --format=table
